The gist of it is that Linux is Linux. What (mainly) differs between the distributions is the amount of prepackaged guff you get, and what package manager / repos they use.

In short, you can install Ubuntu and run i3wm just like any Arch user can, or you can install Arch and put Unity on it (somehow) if that's your thing.
